Test Case Name: Test case to verify EOS functionality of the Non-Driver PCB
Pre Action:
1.Power Supply - ON
2.Connect the Trace32 hardware to the PC with  target board.
3.Connect 560 ? pull-up resisto between EOS_OUT and the 3.3 V power supply.The IPB_GND shall be shorted to the external 3.3 V supply ground.
4.Run SmartBuApp.bat to open GUI Panel
5.Go to Section Setting
6.Click on Brouse option to select elf  > To Falsh elf
7.Select Variant - Non NFC Version
8.Click on Connect Trace32 and wait for connection
9.Click on Start Code (Go) and  verify Debugger Running
Test Steps:
1.Select Tab > EOS
2.Set signal DO_EOS =NOT ACTIVE 
3.Click on Run Symbol
(Read voltage betweeen   TP612 (AI_EOS_DIAG) and GND )
